entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: Goddess for whom a girl tends golden apples, given to those who please her.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: Hot-climate region whose plants grow in the garden.

entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: Shaded region whose fungi grow in the garden.

events.summary: A young girl warns the narrator off and says she tends the apples for Karametra.
events.quote: I tend the apples for Karametra
